build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable MoE experts and composition embedding for molecular property prediction
merge_mole_model_escnmd: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MoE model into a single Linear layer backbone for single-dataset inference
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific MoE experts using a dataset mapping
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares one head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
set_mole_coefficients: set MoE expert mixing coefficients on the eSCNMDMoeBackbone using atomic numbers, batch, and CSD mixed embeddings
